scheme_definitions.W0: Exact frozen M3: top if p_top>=0.68 or p_top/p_second>=1.85, else retained-mode probability expectation.
scheme_definitions.W1: All retained modes, original-probability expectation: sum(p_i*center_i).
scheme_definitions.W2: Top two retained modes only, probabilities normalized within top two; single mode unchanged.
scheme_definitions.W3: All modes, sqrt(probability)-normalized expectation; exponent fixed at 0.5.
scheme_definitions.W4: All modes, squared-probability-normalized expectation; exponent fixed at 2.
scheme_definitions.W6: Dominant probability capped at 0.60; remaining 0.40 distributed over other modes in original relative proportions; unchanged if top<=0.60; single mode unchanged.
scheme_definitions.W7: Probability-weighted Huber location on mode centers; delta fixed to frozen M3 source huber_delta_mm=45.
scheme_definitions.W8: Continuous top-vs-W1 blend: s=max(p_top/0.68,(p_top/p_second)/1.85), alpha=s/(1+s), output=alpha*top+(1-alpha)*W1; single mode unchanged.
